intro.label: Reviews
intro.title: What people said afterwards.
intro.lede: Feedback from network owners, community managers and staff leads I've worked with over the years.

items.quote: We had four servers, three different permission systems and nobody left who understood any of them. Naed spent a week just auditing before he touched a single config, then rebuilt the whole thing without a day of downtime. Six months on we still haven't had to call him, which is about the best thing I can say about anyone.
items.author: Ryan Keller

items.quote: Our Discord was 400 people and completely unreadable. He restructured all of it and set up onboarding that filters people properly. We're past twelve thousand members now and my mod team is doing less work than they were at four hundred.
items.author: Mira Vance

items.quote: Sixty custom items, a full quest chain, and an economy that didn't collapse in week two. He modelled the numbers before building any of it, which nobody else I spoke to even offered to do.
items.author: Jonas Thiel

items.quote: He came in during an emergency. Our permissions were broken mid season and half the staff were locked out. Sorted in a weekend, then he stayed on and fixed the reason it happened in the first place, which turned out to be a management problem rather than a technical one.
items.author: Sofia Lund

items.quote: We were about to pay for a hardware upgrade we didn't need. He read our timings report, pulled out nine plugins and retuned the config, and tick time went from 41ms to 12ms. A one off fee instead of a bigger bill every month.
items.author: Nadia Petrova
